## **1. Core Kit Structure**

The **Kit** is the central entity representing a "Kit-of-Parts" system. Here are the actual struct/type definitions from each language:

### **Go** ([semio/go/semio.go](semio/go/semio.go#L1881-L1910))

```go
    Authors     []Author
    Remote, Homepage, License, Preview, Icon, Image, Description *string
    Attributes  []Attribute      // Key-value metadata
    CreatedAt   string

}
```

### **Rust** ([semio/rs/lib.rs](semio/rs/lib.rs#L1172-L1198))

```rust
}
```

### **TypeScript** ([semio/js/index.ts](semio/js/index.ts#L7223))
Uses Zod validation schema with same structure, plus projections:
- `KitMeta`: Scalar-only fields (no arrays)
- `KitShallow`: Nested entities as Meta-level items for shallow APIs

### **C#/.NET** ([semio/net/Semio/Semio.cs](semio/net/Semio/Semio.cs#L1-L300))
Uses classes with similar structure; includes constants for limits and encoding utilities.

### **Python** ([semio/py/main.py](semio/py/main.py#L1-L300))
Uses Pydantic dataclasses with field validators and GraphQL schema support.

## **2. Key Child Entities**

### **Types** (Component Type Definitions)
Defined starting at [semio/go/semio.go](semio/go/semio.go#L1360)
```go
type Type struct {
    Guid        string
    Name        string
    Parent      *TypeId          // Hierarchical inheritance
    IsAbstract  *bool
    Virtual     *bool
    Unit        *string
    Stock       *int
    Models      []Model          // 3D representations
    Connectors  []Connector      // Connection points with spatial position
    Props       []Prop           // Property values
    Authors     []AuthorId
    Concepts    []ConceptId
    Icon        *string
    Image       *string
    Description *string
    Attributes  []Attribute
}
```

### **Designs** (Design Compositions)
Collections of placed pieces with connections:
```go
type Design struct {
    Guid        string
    Name        string
    Pieces      []Piece          // Placed component instances
    Connections []Connection     // Between pieces
    CanScale    *bool
    CanMirror   *bool
    Props       []Prop
    // ... metadata fields
}
```

### **Connectors** (3D Connection Points)
```go
type Connector struct {
    Guid      string
    Name      *string
    Point     Point            // 3D position {X, Y, Z}
    Direction Vector           // 3D direction {X, Y, Z}
    T         float64          // Parameter along curve
    Mandatory *bool
    Port      *PortId          // Port type
    Props     []Prop
}
```

### **Qualities** (Measurable Properties)
```go
type Quality struct {
    Guid          string
    Key           string
    Name          string
    Kind          QualityKind   // Bitfield: General, Type, Design, Piece, Connection, Connector
    Default       *float64
    Formula       *string
    DefaultSiUnit *string
    DefaultImperialUnit *string
    Min, Max      *float64
    MinExcluded, MaxExcluded *bool
    CanScale      *bool
    Benchmarks    []Benchmark   // Threshold values
}
```

### **Ports** (Connector Compatibility)
```go

    Guid            string
    Name            string
    Description     *string
    Icon            *string
    CompatiblePorts []PortId     // Defines which ports connect
}
```
